Access.name: isClienteFiduciaria
Access.Query: select case when count(*) > 0 then 'S' else 'N' end from CLL.CLI where CLI_C = ? and CLI_C_GRUPPO = '273'

Access.name: existOnePep
Access.Query: select case when ( (select count(*) from CLL.CLI_ADEGUATA_VERIFICA where CLI_C in (codClienti) and trim(PEP) = 'S') + (select count(*) from CLL.INR_CLI_ELETTR_REP where ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE in (codClienti) and trim(CLI_F_PEP) = 'S') ) = 0 then 'N' else 'S' end from dual

Access.name: gradoRischioResidenza
Access.Query:
select distinct pae.COD_RISCH_RICLAGG from cll.v_indcli cli inner join utly.dom_naz naz on cli.NAZ_C_NAZ = naz.COD_NAZ_CLI inner join cll.paestero pae on naz.cod_naz_uic_cdcri = pae.paestero_c_uic where naz.gstd_f_esist = 'S' and pae.gstd_f_esist = 'S' and cli.TIPIND_C_TIP_IND = '01' and sysdate between naz.DAT_INIZ_VALID and naz.DAT_FINE_VALID and cli.CLI_C = ?
union
select distinct pae.COD_RISCH_RICLAGG from cll.INR_INDCLI_ELETTR_REP cli inner join utly.dom_naz naz on cli.NAZ_C_NAZ = naz.COD_NAZ_CLI inner join cll.paestero pae on naz.cod_naz_uic_cdcri = pae.paestero_c_uic WHERE naz.gstd_f_esist = 'S' and pae.gstd_f_esist = 'S' and cli.TIPIND_C_TIP_IND = '01' and sysdate between naz.DAT_INIZ_VALID and naz.DAT_FINE_VALID AND cli.ASSGNCLIAGE_C_POTZLE = ?
